name: get_resource_maintenance
description:
Retrieves details about a specific resource maintenance.

**Parameters**

* `name` (string, Required): The resource name of the resource within a service, in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/resourceMaintenances/{resource_maintenance_id}`.

**Return Value**

The ResourceMaintenance resource object if found.

parameters.description: The request structure for the GetResourceMaintenance method.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the resource within a service.
